enroll_lead: Enter your work email to receive a one-time verification code.

home.headline: What do you need to send?
home.body: Your analyst asked for evidence from this phone. Follow the guided steps — we never collect anything without your consent.
home.android_subtitle: System diagnostic ZIP via Developer options
home.ios_subtitle: Hardware button combo, then share the archive
home.message_subtitle: Share, screenshot, or paste the message

consent.title: Consent before upload
consent.footer: The file is encrypted on this phone to the case key before upload. You can review or discard later from My data.
consent.checkbox: I understand and consent to send this artefact
consent.disclosure_android: A bugreport can include installed apps, system logs, Wi‑Fi networks, account identifiers, and sometimes location history.
consent.disclosure_ios: A sysdiagnose can include process lists, system logs, crash reports, network details, and other diagnostics collected by iOS.
consent.disclosure_message: The message text, metadata you entered, and any screenshots will be sent encrypted to the analyst handling your case.

android_bugreport.title: Android bugreport
android_bugreport.headline: We need a full system bugreport
android_bugreport.body: Android will create a ZIP with logs, installed apps, and crash data. You stay in control: you start it from Developer options and share it into this app.

ios_sysdiagnose.title: iOS sysdiagnose
ios_sysdiagnose.headline: Prepare the phone
ios_sysdiagnose.body: Unlock the phone, connect to Wi‑Fi, and charge above 30%. Sysdiagnose is heavy on CPU and storage.

message_report.title: Suspicious message
message_report.lead: We never open links on this device. Confirm any URL we detect below.
